blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines—A Filipino seafarer injured following a reported drone attack on an oil tanker in the Persian Gulf is receiving medical treatment in Qatar, the Department of Migrant Workers (DMW) said. The DMW also said in a tatement on Tuesday that authorities are checking on the status of 24 other Filipino crew members aboard the vessel. The oil tanker ACER was reportedly hit by three drones on Oct. 7, prompting the Qatar Navy and Qatar Coast Guard to rescue the injured seafarer and bring him to Hamad General Hospital in Doha, according to the DMW.
